title: Three Seasons and One Short Net
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：ship　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ship 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the fisherman ① boarded the ship that no boatman in the harbour would have described, and he said the boarding was the whole of the season. The ② ship, meaning the vessel itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; a ship, he said, is the only thing in a harbour that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ ship in that harbour had the same short net beside it, and the ④ ship at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A ship, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the fisherman said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the ship was the whole of the matter, meaning the voyage and not the vessel. The ⑥ ship, meaning the voyage and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; ship, he said, is either something you board or the only word that means both a vessel and a voyage. He said the voyage is the part they remember.

By 1993 the ⑦ ship had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ ship of the whole thing, the fisherman wrote in July, was one harbour and three seasons of describing; ship, he said, is either the catch at the far pier or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ship I remember is the vessel described in the logbook, which closed in 1995 and is still described as the quietest in the harbour. A ⑩ ship, my mother said in 1997, is the only vessel that improves by being described; every ship, she said, is a voyage that has agreed to look like a vessel. She said the voyage was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 船；轮船（指渔港里每一艘旁边的那一艘）
B. n. 船；轮船（指那艘船本身，与小小的渔网相对）
C. 固定搭配：board the ship 登这一艘船
D. n. 船；轮船（指留给孩子们起的那一网）
E. n. 船之事（抽象总称，指一处渔港的船之事）
F. n. 船；轮船（指航海日志里写到、被描述的那一艘）
G. n. 船、航程（指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 航程（抽象总称，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: boarded the ship that no boatman in the harbour would have described
The ship, meaning the vessel itself and not the net
the ship at the far pier
the ship was the whole of the matter
the ship had become a line in a logbook
The ship of the whole thing
A ship, my mother said in 1997

answers.why: board the ship 意为“登这一艘船”，1988 年那位渔人把渔港里没有一位船工肯描述的一艘船做了一遍。
ship 意为“船；轮船”，指那艘船本身而不是小小的渔网，它经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被描述。
ship 意为“船；轮船”，指渔港里每一艘旁边的那一艘，每一艘旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。
ship 意为“船；轮船”，指最远那座码头的留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
ship 意为“船、航程”，指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这艘航程就是那件事的全部。
ship 意为“航程”，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那艘船，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
ship 意为“船；轮船”，指航海日志里写到、被描述的那一艘，到 1993 年这一艘成了航海日志里的一行。
ship 意为“船之事”，渔人七月写道，整件事的船之事是一处渔港和三个汛期的描述。
ship 意为“船；轮船”，我记得的是航海日志里描述过的那一艘，1995 年归港了，至今仍被说成渔港里最安静的一艘。
ship 为抽象总称，母亲 1997 年说，船是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的船。
